evidence_scope: smoke-only engineering verification; not main-paper evidence

cg.iteration_budget_revision_reason: The initial 100-iteration tuning attempt wrote 56 hashed current-GGN failure records before stopping; the first failure was delta=0.5, seed=2000, ridge=0.1, bonus=0.1 at round 484 with residual 8.647020e-6. A clean 300-iteration restart then failed before evaluation at delta=0.5, seed=2008, ridge=0.1, bonus=0.5, round 2761 with residual 4.714088e-6. A development-only periodic residual-replacement diagnostic also failed at round 174 with residual 5.467890e-6. No evaluation policy was run, and the full Wheel study remains a recorded failed benchmark.
cg.tolerance_deviation_reason: Pre-evaluation development-only seed 1900 pilots failed the 1e-10 check after 190.04 seconds and the 1e-8 check at round 2955 after 440.94 seconds (relative residual 1.337249e-8). The 1e-6 target is frozen before tuning/evaluation and every solve remains independently residual checked.

resolved_config.description: Canonical five-action Wheel benchmark over four difficulty radii with pooled leakage-free tuning and explicit random, safe, and privileged-oracle controls.
resolved_config.evaluation_seed_count_decision: The permitted 30-seed option is frozen before tuning/evaluation because one development-only full-horizon current-GGN trajectory took 190.04 seconds and failed before completion; no tuning or evaluation outcome was inspected.

method_semantics.all_layer_diagonal_ucb: Local all-parameter diagonal linearized UCB with one matched full-network update per round; not a published baseline implementation.
method_semantics.cc_ucb_full_ggn_cg: Local current-parameter full-GGN UCB diagnostic with a fixed operator and separately residual-checked CG solve for every action.
method_semantics.frozen_backbone_last_layer_ucb: Local UCB with the initialized tanh backbone held fixed and an action-disjoint Bayesian last-layer head; not an official published implementation.
method_semantics.greedy: Local full-network greedy policy with one matched full-network update per round and no uncertainty bonus.
method_semantics.linear_ts: Local disjoint affine-feature Gaussian linear Thompson sampler.
method_semantics.local_neural_linear: Local NeuralLinear-style Gaussian posterior sampler with an online tanh representation, action-disjoint Bayesian last-layer head, and one matched full-network update per round; not an official or faithful published implementation.
method_semantics.local_neural_ts: Local full-network linearized Gaussian Thompson sampler; not a pinned or faithful reproduction of published NeuralTS code.
method_semantics.local_neural_ucb: Local full-network linearized UCB implementation; not a pinned or faithful reproduction of published NeuralUCB code.
method_semantics.oracle: Privileged non-learner control that selects the true optimal action before reward observation.
method_semantics.random: Uniform random action independent of context and oracle information.
method_semantics.safe: Always selects the canonical safe action zero.

resolved_config.name: wheel_benchmark

omitted_methods.kfac: Excluded rather than labeling a local block approximation as faithful KFAC.
omitted_methods.lofi: Excluded because no faithful pinned implementation is available in this repository.
